title: Improving constraint-based discovery with robust propagation and reliable LLM priors
abstract: arXiv:2509.23570v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning causal structure from observational data is central to scientific modeling and decision-making. Constraint-based methods aim to recover conditional independence (CI) relations in a causal directed acyclic graph (DAG). Classical approaches such as PC and subsequent methods orient v-structures first and then propagate edge directions from these seeds, assuming perfect CI tests and exhaustive search of separating subsets -- assumptions often violated in practice, leading to cascading errors in the final graph. translated_title: 通过稳健传播与可靠的LLM先验改进基于约束的因果发现
translated_abstract: 从观测数据中学习因果结构是科学建模与决策的核心。基于约束的方法旨在恢复因果有向无环图（DAG）中的条件独立性（CI）关系。经典方法（如PC算法及其后续方法）首先确定v-结构的方向，然后从这些种子出发传播边的方向，其前提是假设CI检验完美且对分离子集进行穷尽搜索——这些假设在实践中往往不成立，从而导致最终因果图中出现级联错误。近期研究探索将大语言模型（LLM）作为专家，通过向其提示节点集合来获取边的方向，以便在假设不满足时增强边的定向。然而，此类方法隐含地假设专家是完美的，这对于容易产生幻觉的LLM来说并不现实。我们提出了MosaCD，这是一种因果发现方法，它从由CI检验和LLM先验共同导出的高置信度种子集合出发来传播边的方向……
tldr: 该论文提出MosaCD方法，将条件独立性检验与可靠的大语言模型先验结合生成高置信度种子集合，并进行稳健的边方向传播，从而解决经典基于约束的因果发现方法在假设不满足时产生的级联错误问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MosaCD, a causal discovery method that propagates edge orientations from a high-confidence seed set derived from both CI tests and reliable LLM priors, mitigating the cascading errors of classical constraint-based methods when their assumptions are violated in practice.
